subject: Security MAP: SOC 2 evidence, SIG/CAIQ & data retention timeline
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@finflow.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security MAP & evidence requests (SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ, retention)

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited by the fit between FinFlow's payment flows and our Dedicated tier. Per our QA and procurement conversations, I've attached a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out the commercial milestones alongside the security/compliance gating items we need to close before we can finalize the PO. High-level asks on the security track: 

- SOC 2: copy of the latest SOC 2 Type II report or AOC (we typically accept an AOC plus evidence metadata) — target: receive by 2027-03-22.
- SIG/CAIQ: completed spreadsheet or CAIQ export covering cloud controls (Network, Encryption, Key Mgmt). If you have a vendor questionnaire portal export, that works — target: 2027-03-12.
- DPA: redlines to our standard DPA (I'll attach the template link) — legal would like a first pass by 2027-03-18.
- Data retention/export: confirmation of retention windows for tokens, logs, and raw payloads, plus deletion process and export format for customer data. Need a short retention table for contract attachment.

Proposed security acceptance milestone in the MAP: "Security gating complete" by 2027-04-01 so procurement can issue PO the week of 2027-04-05. If any of these dates are tight on your side, tell me which items we should prioritize.

Attachments: a one-page MAP (summary), SOC2_AOC_request_template.xlsx (format we prefer for evidence requests).

Would you be open to a 30-minute security sync next Wednesday 2027-03-10 at 10:00 PT to walk through the SIG/CAIQ and the retention table? I can invite our security engineer.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0124

Attachments (stubs):
- 2027-03-04_Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (1 page MAP, milestones & owners)
- SOC2_AOC_request_template.xlsx (spreadsheet with evidence checklist)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@finflow.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finflow.com
Date: 2027-03-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security MAP & evidence requests (SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ, retention)

Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear MAP and timeline. We're aligned on the overall plan; a few notes from our security/ops side: 

On SOC 2: We can provide the SOC 2 Type II AOC and an inventory of controls/evidence artifacts. The report is with our external auditor; estimated delivery of the AOC: 2027-03-20. We can also provide a redacted report if needed sooner.

SIG/CAIQ: Attached is our completed CAIQ export (FinFlow_SIG-CAIQ_20270305.xlsx). Please confirm which sections you need filled in with additional evidence links (e.g., key rotation, KMS logs).

DPA & retention: Our legal team wants to see Redwood's DPA before we invest time on redlines. Can you send the DPA template link you mentioned? Also, our default retention is 90 days for payload logs and 365 days for transaction metadata; deletion requests are handled via our support API and audited weekly. We can surface export as JSON or CSV.

Encryption: All data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 via cloud KMS; we use customer-managed keys for enterprise customers — happy to include key rotation schedule in the retention table.

We can do the 3/10 security sync; 10:00 PT works. I'll have our security engineer (cc'd address above) join and bring the CAIQ context.

– Elena
Head of Security Programs, FinFlow
Elena.Ruiz@finflow.com

Thanks again — looking forward to the sync.
